# netbox_token (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox token (`/api/users/tokens/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_token" "example" {
  id = 123
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_token" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/users/tokens/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Disable to temporarily revoke this token without deleting it. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `expires` (String) Expires. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `key` (String) v2 token identification key.
- `last_used` (String) Last Used. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `pepper_id` (Number) ID of the cryptographic pepper used to hash the token (v2 only).
- `token` (String) Token.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the User (`netbox_user`).
- `version` (Number) Version. Valid values: `1`, `2`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) Permit create/update/delete operations using this token. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
